svg.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Noto Color Emoji', sans-serif
svg.title: Faalak AI: lead and booking alerts delivered to the owner's WhatsApp
svg.desc: A phone shows the business owner's WhatsApp chat with Faalak AI: a new lead alert, a booked appointment, a CRM update and the owner's reply. Floating cards show the call answered, the lead sent to WhatsApp and the appointment confirmed.
